purpose: Test whether dependency-pipelined placement can retain faithful FaaSRank throughput while reducing stage wait and the latency-cost product that gives OCS its QPR advantage.

diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.code_level_mechanistic_difference: FaaSRank and the V81 faithful initializer collect PreAllDone players, whereas OCS collects PreAllSched players. PreAllSched makes a child placeable after all parents have placements, before all parents finish, creating one-layer-ahead dependency pipelining.
diagnosis_frozen_before_implementation.root_cause_hypothesis: The remaining QPR deficit is dominated by DAG stage wait rather than node-score weights. A faithful FaaSRank node scorer operating on the PreAllSched frontier can combine throughput-oriented placement with earlier downstream container preparation.

scientific_boundary.E530_E539_disposition: V81 result-blind screen evidence; may motivate a new mechanism family but may not validate or tune V82
scientific_boundary.E540_E559_disposition: permanently unused V81 confirmation reserve; inputs were never generated

candidate.player_frontier: PreAllSched: a function is eligible only after every parent has an assigned node, whether or not those parents have completed
candidate.initializer: exact frozen faithful FaaSRank request iteration, DAG walk, node score, deterministic epsilon selection and rolling diversity history over the dependency-pipeline player set
candidate.coordination: unchanged paper-utility best response; every nontrivial move must strictly improve paper utility and the outcome-blind completion proxy while keeping the moving player's FaaSRank score nonworse within EPSILON

execution_order: Commit this plan before modifying scheduler code or generating any E560-E589 artifact.
Implement only the single registered pipeline profile and required observability; do not change any baseline, paper utility, reference search, common HPA, workload or environment weight.
Pass focused pipeline tests, all sche_nash tests, rustfmt, cargo check and release build; freeze source commit and binary hash before input generation.
Generate only E560-E569 screen inputs; capture each base tape once and bind identical derived tapes to all ten methods.
Build exactly ten state-matched candidate references, then execute ninety baselines and ten candidate runs strictly serially without opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require 100 attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact ten-way pairing, one runtime identity and a result-free joint audit before simultaneous reveal.
If and only if all three arithmetic-mean gates pass, freeze the unchanged candidate and commit a confirmation execution receipt before generating E570-E589 inputs.
If any gate fails, retain all artifacts, do not tune on E560-E569, generate no E570-E589 inputs and close the dependency-pipeline family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten E560-E569 seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput divided by drained-cohort mean latency and cost across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold: For each metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine same-seed baselines.
analysis.screen_gate: The candidate must strictly exceed all three baseline thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-each-baseline paired BCa 95% intervals without changing the arithmetic-mean gate.
analysis.mechanism_diagnostics: After the joint blind audit, report pipeline/incomplete-parent player counts and move counts; they cannot alter the frozen decision.
analysis.screen_success_action: Authorize preparation, but not success, of the untouched E570-E589 formal confirmation block.
analysis.screen_failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on E560-E569, generate no confirmation inputs and close the dependency-pipeline family.
